Are you looking for ultimate freedom on the road and weekly payments in your bank account? As a Delivery Driver AH Online in Leiden, you will enjoy independence and a great starting salary. Step into your office on wheels and make countless customers happy! 🚚💨💸

What we offer
- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks
- Standard 8.33% holiday allowance to do fun things
- Plenty of holiday days for your well-deserved rest
- Access to helpful training courses to keep growing
- Freedom on the road with a truck full of goodies
- Guaranteed pension accrual from your first workday

Who you are
To get started as a Delivery Driver AH Online, it is important that you like to stay active. You know exactly how to navigate safely through the traffic in Leiden. Furthermore, you bring the following for this top job: 🚗💼🏃

- You are in possession of a valid driving license B.
- You speak fluent English or Dutch for smooth customer contact.
- You are available for at least two days a week to rock this job.

What will you do
Your day starts at the distribution center in Leiden, where you load up the iconic blue box truck. Once on the road, you are the boss of your own route with a great playlist in the background. #baanrader 🚗 Work pleasure is guaranteed, because carrying crates to the kitchen means you can skip the gym today! 🎶📦💪

Where will you work
At Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, there is an amazing atmosphere at the HUB. You start with a nice chat with friendly colleagues before you hit the road independently. The work pleasure really shines through when you greet every customer with a smile and make their day better! 🏢🤝😊

Job application
Ready to start as a Delivery Driver AH Online? Hit that button and apply today. You will always get a response from us within 24 hours, so what are you waiting for! 🚀👇🎉  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

Looking for a flexible job with a great salary where you can start right away? Come work as a warehouse worker at CB in Culemborg! With a starting salary of € 15,49 per hour (which can go up to € 28.13 per hour with shift allowances!) and a work atmosphere rated an 8+ by current employees, this is the place to be! You can work until the end of the year, at least. Sound like your ideal match? Continue reading and discover more! 🚀 #baanrader

What we offer
- A great starting salary of € 15,49 gross per hour!
- Allowances making your pay up to € 28.13 per hour!
- 100% public transport reimbursement!
- Work at a top employer rated an 8+!
- Choose your own shifts!
- Long term work and chance of permanent contract!

Who you are
To keep the book distribution center running smoothly, you meet the following objective requirements:

- You are available to work full-time (40 hours a week)
- You can work at least 2 of the following shifts: 06:30-15:00, 14:00-22:30, or 22:30-06:00
- You are available to work on Sunday and Mondays
- You speak and understand enough English or Dutch to have a conversation

What will you do
As a warehouse worker at CB, your day will be filled with variety! You might unpack incoming pallets loaded with books and sort them into bins. Or you could be stationed at a pick station, scanning books into the computer system and labeling boxes for shipment. You ensure that orders are picked and prepared accurately so readers receive their favorite books on time. Easy peasy! 📚✨

Your daily activities as a warehouse worker at a glance:

- Unpacking incoming freight and sorting books into logistics bins
- Scanning, labeling, and registering books at high-tech picking stations
- Preparing orders neatly so your colleagues can send them out on transport

Where will you work
You will be joining the warehouse of CB in Culemborg as a warehouse worker! CB is the biggest book distribution hub in the Netherlands. The working atmosphere is super friendly, informal, an

As a warehouse employee at Zara in Leidschendam, you start your day at 7:00 AM. You work 3 to 8 hours per week, spread over Monday and Thursday mornings. This is perfect if you want flexibility alongside your studies or another job. The pay is good and you work with great colleagues in the heart of Leidschendam.
During your shift, you help unpack deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and make sure everything ends up neatly in the right spot. You check the stock and ensure the store always has enough products. After your tasks, you help keep the warehouse tidy. You stay active and have plenty of contact with your team.
This job is ideal if you want to start quickly, enjoy teamwork, and like to be hands-on. No experience is needed. Grab this opportunity and apply today! ✨

- At least VMBO (secondary education) working and thinking level

- Experience is not required but is a plus

- Able to work independently and in a team

- Physically fit and proactive

- You speak Dutch or English

As an assembly worker, you will be responsible for assembling and testing electronic products in a modern, high-tech working environment. You will work full-time on the evening shift from 3:00 PM to midnight. The position offers opportunities for personal and professional development, including internal training.

Your responsibilities include following digital work instructions, collecting components, assembling products, and performing quality checks. You will work with tasks such as screwing, manual gluing, assembly, and functional testing. You may also operate robots and be responsible for programming and quality control.

You will carefully record your work and work closely with your fellow assembly workers to meet deadlines and maintain high-quality standards. This is a long-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract, depending on your performance and commitment. Would you like to work in a high-tech environment with plenty of opportunities to grow? Apply now for this exciting Assembly Worker position!

- Mbo-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Technical affinity and experience with fine electronics is a plus
- Good command of the English language
- Flexibility to work overtime and a precise, accurate working attitude
- A team player with a strong eye for detail

What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

Are you looking for a hands-on technical job in an international company with an informal working atmosphere? Join a team that values quality, sustainability, and continuous improvement. In this varied role, you will work with machine parts, learn new skills through training, and occasionally visit customers on location. With flexible working hours, development opportunities, and the chance for a permanent position, this is a great step if you enjoy working with technology and solving problems.

Manpower is looking for a DI/CPO Engineer for a company based in Gronsveld.

In this role, you work on assembling and disassembling light machine parts, including cleaning and packaging. You handle simple mechanical and electronic repairs and sometimes work on-site at customer locations. Ensuring a smooth logistics process and learning to operate and read software through training, will also be part of the job. Furthermore, you also install machines by mounting cables and leveling equipment.

It’s a varied job where you keep learning and developing your technical skills every day.

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary between €3,000 and €3,800 per month 
    
- Reimbursement of travel costs
    
- Full-time job of 38 to 40 hours a week 
    
- Direct contract with our client 
    
- Opportunities for internal and external courses
    
- Permanent employment with good performance

    - At least a completed LBO/MBO education
    
- Demonstrable affinity with technology
    
- Strong problem-solving abilities
    
- Logical approach to troubleshooting
    
- Preferably experienced in similar roles
    
- Effective communication skills
    
- Good command of Dutch and basic English

Do you meet the job requirements and are you interested in this position? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

Wat je gaat doen In the position of productiemedewerker, you will play a key role in ensuring that medical nutrition products are packaged and labeled accurately. Working in a clean and well-organized environment, you will focus on precision and teamwork to maintain an efficient production process. With your attention to detail and collaborative mindset, you will contribute to the smooth operation of an internationally recognized pharmaceutical company.
What You Will Do:
- Re-packaging: accurately re-pack medical nutrition cans according to established guidelines.
- Order handling: move and lift products weighing up to a maximum of 13 kilograms.
- System use: operate computer systems for label printing and scanning tasks.
- Team collaboration: work closely with your team to ensure a smooth and efficient production process.
- Working in a 2‑shift schedule:- 05:45 – 14:15
- 14:30 – 23:00

- Hourly salary of €15,25

- Full-time role, 40 hours per week.
- Travel allowance of €0.25 per km (from 6 km).
- Free parking at our Breda location.
- Short onboarding period with initial training provided.

At Start People, we operate on the principle of equal pay; your terms and conditions of employment always match those of colleagues who are employed directly by the client. This means that, in addition to your hourly rate, your terms and conditions of employment also include, for example, the number of days off, allowances, time-off-in-lieu payments and other pay components.
   Functie-eisen We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative production worker to join our team.
- Reside near Breda.
- Full-time availability; flexible with shift work.
- Comfortable with repetitive tasks.
- Fluent in Dutch or English.
- Willing to use computer systems.

Are you looking for a hands-on role where you can immediately see the results of your work? Do you enjoy working with precision and want to be part of an international high-tech company? Then this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you.

What are you going to do?
As a Packing Operator, you play a key role in ensuring high-quality precision products reach customers around the world safely and in perfect condition. Your responsibilities include:

- Reviewing and processing work instructions
- Selecting the correct packaging materials
- Creating custom-sized boxes when required
- Performing quality checks on products
- Carefully packaging precision components
- Verifying and registering quantities
- Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe

What do we offer?
- Gross hourly wage of €16.77
- Full-time position in a day shift schedule
- 27 vacation days per year
- Opportunity for a permanent contract
- A stable, innovative, and international working environment
- A supportive team culture focused on quality and collaboration

Where will you work?
Our client is a leading specialist in aluminium precision products. From their facility in Venlo, they manufacture high-quality components for customers in the high-tech, medical, and automotive industries. Innovation, craftsmanship, and quality are at the heart of everything they do.

What do we ask?
- Strong attention to detail and quality
- Good Dutch, German or English language skills, both written and spoken
- Experience in logistics, production, or packaging is an advantage
- The ability to work independently and take ownership
- A practical mindset and flexible attitude

Are you interested?
Apply today or contact Mette or July at +31 (0)77 382 89 46.

As a Reach Truck Driver in Hoofddorp, you ensure that the flow of goods in the warehouse runs smoothly. You start your workday at 08:00 by safely and accurately retrieving pallets from high racks. Throughout the day, you place incoming goods in the correct locations and maintain an organized warehouse. At 17:00, you wrap up your duties and leave behind a tidy working environment.

Responsibilities
 - Moving and retrieving pallets from high racks using a reach truck
 - Storing incoming goods in assigned warehouse locations
 - Checking items for damages and correct quantities
 - Keeping the work area clean and safe
 - Collaborating with team members to hit daily operational goals

We are looking for
 - Practical experience operating a reach truck
 - Good command of the English language
 - Availability from Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00

 - 8% holiday pay

As a reachtruck driver, your main responsibility is order picking from the reachtruck. You drive through the warehouse, collect the correct products and make sure everything ends up in the right place.

Working safely and accurately is very important. If a product is stored in the wrong location, it can take a lot of time to find it again. That is why Galvano is looking for someone who stays focused and works carefully.

You work in a two-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00. Very occasionally, you may also be asked to work a night shift from 22:00 to 06:00 or work on a Saturday.

- You have experience operating a reachtruck
- You have a valid reach truck certificate
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available to work in a two-shift system and are open to occasional night and Saturday shifts
- You work accurately and keep a good overview

Looking for that full-time job with training and growing opportunities? Work only in the day shift? Look no further! You found your  new job as a warehouse employee at Xenos in Waalwijk!
Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- Work in only day shifts
- Full-time work
- Salary of €14,99 per hour
- A friendly and cosy working atmosphere!
- Reimbursement of travel expenses
- Work in different departments

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee:

- You have your own transport to go to Waalwijk.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in day shifts.
- You are available 5 days during the week.

What will you do
Sofas, chairs, confetti cannons, candles, cushions... Xenos has it all! As a warehouse employee, you’ll work among all this fun, colorful stuff. You work at the department for all of the products for the Xenos stores. You’re going to be driving around on an EPT to get all the different products! You put everything where it needs to go. You don’t need any prior experience, we’ll teach you everything!
This job is for the dayshifts only. You'll work from 07:00h until 16:00h. Awesome, right?!
Xenos pays different wages per age:

- 18 jaar: €7,50/hour
- 19 jaar: €8,99/hour
- 20 jaar: €11,99/hour
- 21+ jaar: €14,99/hour

Where will you work
You have probably already seen the Xenos stores! They are located all throughout the country! You will recognize Xenos by their fun, yellow logo 💛. Xenos has great products for your home. You will often see them in the warehouse! You will also get a great discount at the Xenos stores!
As a warehouse employee you will have great colleagues. You take breaks together and you are well supported by the team leaders. You’ll definitely feel welcome here!

Job application

Ready to kickstart your workday in a dynamic environment? As a warehouse worker, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. You will be working at a client of ours in Hoofddorp, the absolute specialist in exotic products. This is a stable position where you can truly build for the long term!

You start the day with a fresh cup of coffee, have a quick, to-the-point check-in with your team leader, and dive straight into the warehouse. From collecting orders on the EPT to getting freight ready for transport: you stay physically active, keep an overview, and work together with your team to supply stores and customers on time.

Tasks:
 - Order picking exotic products in various storage locations efficiently and safely.
 - Operating an EPT to move goods quickly and safely through the warehouse.
 - Moving freight and stock to loading docks, storage areas, and delivery vehicles.
 - Stacking and packing goods neatly for safe shipment.
 - Keeping the work environment clean, organized, and safe.
 - Working closely with your team and coordinating with connected stores.
 - Working longer hours on busy days whenever you want to.

What we are looking for:
 - A true doer who is physically in great shape and loves to roll up their sleeves.
 - An EPT certificate is required (don't have one yet? We will arrange it for you!).
 - You are looking for stability and a long-term commitment.
 - Available for the fixed working hours from 06:00 to 15:00.
 - Willing to work two Saturdays per month from 06:00 to 11:00.
 - Ability to stay organized and perform well under pressure during peak times.
 - Good communication skills in Dutch or English to understand work instructions.
 - Living in or near Hoofddorp, such as Amsterdam, Aalsmeer, Haarlem, or Nieuw-Vennep.

What we offer:
 - An attractive salary that perfectly matches your effort and experience.
 - A great 50% allowance on all hours worked on Saturday!
 - Plenty of opportunities to regularly work extra hours if you wan

Are you looking for a hands-on job in a fast-paced environment? We are looking for a Reach Truck Driver to receive, inspect, and prepare goods for transport. 

In this role, you will operate a reach truck, handle raw materials, and organize finished products for shipment. From time to time, you will also transport products to and from the freezer. Don't worry, we provide all the protective clothing you need to stay warm.

You must be able to communicate in either Dutch or English.

You will work from Monday to Friday in a two-shift schedule. The morning shift runs from 06:00 to 15:00, and the evening shift runs from 14:00 to 23:00.

For all hours worked between 18:00 and 23:00, you will receive a 133% shift allowance. In addition, you will receive extra compensation for working in the freezer.

Your starting salary is €18,38 per hour, including ADV and the freezer allowance. During the applicable evening shift hours, your hourly wage increases to €23,84

- Valid Reach Truck Certificate
- Reach truck driving experience is an advantage
- Good command of Dutch or English
- Willing to work in a cold environment

As a production operator, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the filling and packaging process. In this full-time role, you’ll work 37.5 hours per week, leading team members, setting up machines, and solving minor technical issues. You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop yourself through internal trainings and there are ample prospects for growth within the organization. This is a permanent position offering a stable workplace with clear working hours.

You start your workday with a brief handover and by checking the production schedule. Then, you allocate tasks and give clear instructions to the team. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of filling and packaging, conduct checks on weight and labeling, and keep a close eye on production progress. You’ll also resolve minor malfunctions and ensure a clean working environment.

Do you want to contribute as a production operator to a safe, efficient, and high-quality production process? Apply now and make a difference in a professional team!

- 

- At least mbo working and thinking level

- 2 to 5 years of experience in a similar role

- Proficiency in English

- Living within 10 km of Zaandam

- Leadership experience is a plus

As a warehouse worker through Staffice, you process incoming and outgoing freight for a global logistics provider near Schiphol. Inside the modern warehouse, you keep inventory organized and accurately registered. You work rotating shifts from 06:00 to 15:30 and 14:30 to 23:00. Independent transportation is required to access the facility.

Responsibilities
 - Checking and receiving incoming goods
 - Placing items and pallets onto storage racks
 - Packing and staging orders for outgoing transport
 - Performing quality checks with scanning devices
 - Driving forklifts and electric pallet jacks
 - Keeping the workspace orderly and safe
 - Working together with team members to achieve daily targets
 - Following safety guidelines and operational standards

Requirements
 - Basic knowledge or experience in warehouse operations
 - Willingness to earn a forklift or reach truck certificate
 - Availability to work both morning and afternoon shifts
 - Own vehicle (car, scooter, or bike)
 - Proficiency in English or Dutch

What we offer
 - Hourly rate of €17.58 gross
 - Weekend rates up to €35.16 per hour
 - Flexible payment schedule (weekly or every four weeks)
 - 8.33% holiday pay build-up and pension plan
 - Travel costs coverage and paid days off
 - Clean and safe workplace conditions
 - A dedicated contact person at Staffice
 - A great working atmosphere is guaranteed.

Why Staffice?
 - Personal support focused on your career progress

This position near Schiphol is convenient for residents of Haarlem, Nieuw-Vennep, Badhoevedorp, or Aalsmeer. We look at your skills and help you obtain certificates if needed.

Do you want to work as a logistics employee in Tilburg and earn between €3.000,- and €3.300,- gross per month? Are you looking for an active 2-shift job where you do more than only move boxes from A to B? In this role, you prepare food products for shipment, repack orders, check labels and register everything correctly in the system. You work between logistics and production, so your shift stays varied and practical. Together with your colleagues, you make sure every order is checked, packed and ready on time for customers worldwide.

Functieomschrijving:
As a logistics employee in Tilburg, you work between the warehouse and production. You prepare cheese products for shipment, register orders in the system and keep materials moving through the process. The work is active and physically demanding. In general, your tasks are:
• Collecting, repacking and preparing customer orders for shipment.
• Manually lifting, moving and turning products weighing approximately 15 kilograms.
• Placing products into packaging and preparing them for the next production step.
• Checking labels, packaging, quantities, weights and product quality.
• Registering products and orders correctly using scanners and warehouse systems.
• Loading and unloading trucks and checking incoming and outgoing goods.
• Moving products with a pump truck and, when applicable, a forklift or reach truck.
• Working in a refrigerated area for part of the shift when required.
• Reporting deviations and working safely and hygienically according to HACCP guidelines.

Functievereisten:
This role fits someone who enjoys practical logistics work and can stay accurate during a busy shift. You do not need to know the full process yet, but you must be able to follow procedures and handle physical work.
• Experience in logistics, production, order picking or warehouse work.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
• Good command of English.
• Able to regularly lift and move products of around 15 kilograms.
